description: This file defines an immutable data transfer object (DTO) named TellerData for representing teller information within the Fineract organization module. It includes fields such as id, officeId, account IDs, name, description, dates, status, and options for office and staff associations, along with static factory methods for instantiation.

classes.name: TellerData
classes.description: Immutable data object encapsulating details of a teller, including identifiers, account info, operational dates, status, options, and associated options collections.

methods.name: instance
methods.description: Static factory method for creating a new TellerData instance with specified properties.

methods.name: lookup
methods.description: Static method for creating a simplified TellerData instance with only id and name.
